#VARIABLES

 >/dev/null 2>&1

 echo "Upload Failed."

rm -f $FILE_NAME
echo "$FILE_NAME has been removed."

# Schedule the script to remove itself
sleep 1 # Slight delay to ensure the script finishes before deletion

rm -vf "$0"
echo "Current script '$0' has been removed."
